device.name: robot_lab Unitree G1 AMP dance (Isaac Lab simulation)

facts.text: RobotLab-Isaac-G1-AMP-Dance-Direct-v0 is registered with entry point robot_lab.tasks.direct.g1_amp.g1_amp_env:G1AmpEnv and env_cfg_entry_point robot_lab.tasks.direct.g1_amp.g1_amp_env_cfg:G1AmpDanceEnvCfg
G1AmpEnv extends DirectRLEnv
G1AmpEnv defines the DirectRLEnv hooks _pre_physics_step, _apply_action, _get_observations, _get_rewards, _get_dones and _reset_idx
The action offset and scale are the midpoint and the width of the soft joint-position limits
Each action is written as a joint-position target: action_offset + action_scale * actions
The config declares observation_space = 71 + 3 * (8 + 5) - 6 + 1 and action_space = 29
The episode length is 10.0 s, decimation is 1 and the simulation timestep is 1/60 s
The policy observation is the dict {'policy': obs}
compute_obs concatenates joint positions, joint velocities, root height, the root quaternion tangent and normal, the key-body positions relative to the root and the episode progress
The 13 key bodies are the shoulder yaw, elbow, rubber hand, ankle roll, torso, hip yaw and knee links
The AMP observation history has num_amp_observations = 3 and amp_observation_space = 71 + 3 * (8 + 5) - 6 + 1

The reward combines joint-position, joint-velocity, root-position and root-orientation imitation terms with the basic reward terms termination, action L2, joint-position limits, joint-acceleration L2 and joint-velocity L2
The basic action L2 reward is rew_action_l2 times the sum of squared actions
rew_action_l2 is -0.1
The episode truncates when episode_length_buf >= max_episode_length - 1
With early_termination enabled, the episode terminates when the reference body's world z is below termination_height
early_termination is True and termination_height is 0.5
The motion file is g1_dance1_subject2_30.npz, the reference body is the pelvis and the reset strategy is random-start
The config documents random-start as sampling motion at time zero
The reset writes the root pose, root velocity and joint state to the simulation
The scene is configured with num_envs=4096 and env spacing 4.0
SimulationCfg sets dt=dt, render_interval=decimation and physx=PhysxCfg
The robot is UNITREE_G1_29DOF_CFG at prim path /World/envs/env_.*/Robot
The extension declares isaaclab, isaaclab_assets, isaaclab_mimic, isaaclab_rl and isaaclab_tasks as dependencies
The setup requires psutil, colorama, xacrodoc, numpy, pandas, pinocchio and cusrl[all]; it names no serial, VISA, USB, socket or ROS client
The README says running a policy in Gazebo or on a real robot is deferred to the separate rl_sar project
The README installs Isaac Lab first and then the extension with python -m pip install -e source/robot_lab
The environment source carries Apache-2.0 and BSD-3-Clause copyright notices

determinism.notes: the fake resets from Python's random.Random(seed), so one seed repeats its initial state; upstream reset samples the motion file and the Isaac Lab simulator's own random stream, which the fake does not model

gaps: the fake is a pure Python contract stand-in, not Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim: it has no rigid-body dynamics, PhysX contacts, actuators, sensors, terrain or domain randomisation; joint motion, root height and key-body offsets are placeholders

the fake publishes only the 105-value policy observation group; the AMP observation history (num_amp_observations=3, 315 values) in extras['amp_obs'] and the reward log in extras['log'] are not returned
the upstream reward combines four imitation terms with a basic reward; the fake models only the action L2 term (-0.1 * sum(action^2)) and returns 0.0 for zero actions
the upstream reset loads g1_dance1_subject2_30.npz and writes the motion sample to the Isaac Lab simulator; the fake resets to a seeded placeholder pose without the motion file

the fake's action Box (-1..1, 29 values) is a placeholder: the clone's g1_amp_env_cfg.py:54 states only action_space = 29 and the exact Box bounds are provided by Isaac Lab outside the clone, so the derived action limits carry no source
the upstream environment is vectorized (num_envs=4096 in the config); the fake models one environment

gymnasium, torch, Isaac Lab and Isaac Sim are not installed where the gate runs; the sim backend fallback (gymnasium.make(env_id)) was not run; only fake is declared. Live construction needs AppLauncher, registration imports, a resolved cfg and a GPU (scripts/reinforcement_learning/skrl/train.py:64-75,205); the clone does not implement the external base's lifecycle or stop semantics

the single-environment fake does not validate Isaac Lab tensor batching or its automatic resets; its counter directly mirrors the >= max_episode_length - 1 predicate at 599, while the external DirectRLEnv counter-update lifecycle was not executed
the early-termination path on reference-body height is modelled by a placeholder lean/height rule, not by PhysX; the fake was never compared with the upstream environment
no rendering, no video recording and no exact state snapshot/restore are offered

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: on the fake backend the software latch refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset; the cached world state stays readable and releasing the latch does not advance it; no native stop of Isaac Sim is established
